nodes.label: Dataset Class Naming Conflict Problem
nodes.source_location: The Core Problem With Your 12 Datasets
nodes.rationale: 12 datasets use inconsistent class names for the same physical component (e.g., Battery vs Battery Box vs Battery box). YOLO stores labels as numeric IDs so merging without remapping corrupts training data. Binary approach chosen to bypass naming conflict entirely.

nodes.label: Recall-Prioritized Safety-Critical Model Evaluation
nodes.rationale: False negatives (missed defects) are the worst failure mode in safety-critical rail inspection. Target recall >0.85. Binary classification with low threshold maximizes recall vs multi-class which risks confusion between defect subtypes.

nodes.label: POC Philosophy: Visual Confidence over Architecture Complexity
nodes.rationale: POC goal is to showcase AI-powered inspection experience for client confidence, not build production architecture. Focus on smooth video, beautiful AI overlay, reliable detections and real-time feel. Client will notice stable detections, smooth tracking, clean UI and defect highlighting.
